items.title: S&P 500 staples earnings: beats are common, but stock reactions diverge
items.summary: Investing.com -- Five of six S&P 500 retail and wholesale staples companies beat third-quarter EPS estimates. That is about 83%, close to the broad market’s 84% beat rate, with 91% of the S&P 500 reported. Stock prices show beats alone are not enough. Quotes are as of 11:05 AM EST on Nov 18 and may lag live prices slightly.

items.title: Sysco (SYY) Affirms Dividend, Is It Still Below Fair Value?
items.summary: Sysco (SYY) just gave investors two things to think about. The board affirmed a quarterly dividend of US$0.55 per share as its veteran Chief Human Resources Officer prepares to shift into an advisory role. Recent trading tells a mixed story. Sysco’s share price is at US$77.99 with a year to date share price return of 7.39%, while the 1 month move is down 5.14%, and the 1 year total shareholder return sits at 5.73%. items.title: Sysco (SYY) Stock Looks Undervalued After Its 19% Three Year Gain
items.summary: Sysco has delivered an 18.8% share price gain over the past three years, yet the real story for long term holders sits in its ability to keep turning its operations into reliable cash. With the stock recently closing at US$77.99, the live question is how well that price lines up with the cash flows the business is expected to generate. items.title: $300,000 in These 3 Dividend Stocks Could Pay $7,177 a Year
items.summary: Retirees chasing the fattest yield often overlook dividend growers that outrun inflation. A payroll giant, a food distributor, and the world's biggest asset manager each take that slower route, and one of them carries a risk that hits fast when markets fall.
